column1: # Hand-written gold segmentations, for smoke-testing tools/score_segmentation.py.
# This is NOT an evaluation set. It is 40 entries written by hand to exercise
# every branch of the scorer and every case in the segmentation convention
# documented in docs/SEGMENTATION.md. Numbers computed against it say nothing
# about the analyzer's accuracy on real text; use a real gold standard for that.
# The convention: the stem piece is the longest prefix of the surface word
# shared with the lemma, and everything after it belongs to the suffix piece,
# allomorph included. Irregular and suppletive forms stay whole.
# A few entries below are deliberately ones the current lexicon cannot reach,
# so the scorer visibly reports a miss rather than silently agreeing with
# itself: quickly, clearly, slowly, movement and teacher all have the whole
# form stored as its own lexeme, which outranks the derivational reading.
